sentences.text: THIS MSA IS FILED UNDER SECTION 54(2) OF THE LAND  ACQUISITION ACT, AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND DECREE  DATED 23.09.2016 PASSED IN RA[LAC] NO.83/2014 ON THE  FILE OF THE I ADDL. DISTRICT JUDGE, TUMAKURU, PARTLY  ALLOWING THE APPEAL AND SETTING ASIDE THE JUDGMENT  AND DECREE DATED 15.02.2012 PASSED IN LAC NO.272/2006  -2-  NC: 2025:KHC:18899  MSA No. 65 of 2018 HC-KAR ON THE FILE OF THE SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE, GUBBI, PARTLY ALLOWING REFERANCE PETITION FOR ENHANCED COMPENSATION AND ETC.
THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR ORDERS THIS DAY

,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE H.P.SANDESH  ORAL JUDGMENT
This appeal is of the year 2018 and ultimately, it was dismissed vide order dated 17.09.2021.
However, this Court vide order dated 12.12.2024, condoned the delay of 983 days in filing the recalling application and also recalled the order dated 17.09.2021.

Inspite of the said order, till date,
office objections are not complied hence, it is clear that the counsel for the appellants is not pursuing he matter diligently and thus, no purpose would be served in keeping this matter pending from 2018 to 2025 for compliance.

Sd/-
